senses.gloss:
kruṣṭa
------------------------------------------
Indian मुसिच्, especially the sapta-स्वर system (the seven fundamental notes), gradually evolved from the seven notes of sāmagāna used in chanting the hymns of the Sāmaveda. क्रुष्ट is the last of the notes as arranged there. The seven notes of Sāmagāna and their equivalents in the saptasvara system are given below:
of Sāmaveda of Indian Music
prathama ga (gāndhāra)
dvitīya ri (ṛṣabha)
tṛtīya sa (ṣaḍja)
caturtha ni (niṣāda)
mandra dha (daivata)
atisvārya pa (pañcama)
kruṣṭa ma (madhyama)

Thus, क्रुष्ट corresponds to ma or madhyama of Indian मुसिच्.
